positions.title: Product Lead
positions.description: As a Product Lead at Alaiko, I oversee a team of Product Managers to drive the development and launch of our Alaiko’s software solutions. With a keen eye for market trends and customer needs, I lead the charge in delivering products that delight our customers and drive growth for our business.

positions.title: Senior Product Manager
positions.description:
Alaiko is Europe’s leading fulfillment-as-a-service platform that enables online shops to scale their operations without friction. 

My main responsibilities are generating insights from a variety of stakeholder inputs, conceptualising solutions together with engineering and finally owning the business outcome of the developed solutions within my product areas.

positions.title: Product Manager
positions.description: Responsible for a specific product area within the Celonis Intelligent Business Cloud. Working as part of a team with engineers and designers. Typical tasks include building and communicating the product roadmap, prioritising the product backlog, building wireframes, conducting user research, and finally providing all necessary materials to enable each user to harness the product's value.

positions.title: Product Manager
positions.description: Supporting an early stage startup in identifying user needs as well as translating these into a product vision and backlog. Conducting user research to define specific features from abstract user need until actual design. Working together with the CEO to prioritise the product backlog.

positions.title: Research Intern
positions.description: Conducting human-centric-design research with the MIT Media Lab to build collaborative information systems for evolving social movements, such as the DIY biology community. Supporting the MIT Climate CoLab with running their open problem-solving platform tackling climate change.

positions.title: Human-Machine-Interaction Researcher
positions.description: Drafting, conducting and evaluating user studies to shape any kind of interaction between human and cars from 2025 on. Special focus on social robotics and voice control.

positions.title: Business Development Manager
positions.description: Enabling medical professionals as well as Brain-Computer-Interface experts to perform research with latest EEG technology.

positions.title: External Consultant
positions.description: Development of a Smartphone Application (Android) that supports eGym users with their nutrition.

positions.title: External Consultant
positions.description: Creating a comprehensive trend report for Adidas AG in collaboration with 25 fellow students, industry experts, and academic researchers. The trend report included 5 detailed business ideas of which one could be further pursued.

positions.title: Innovation Manager
positions.description: Building up and managing the SAP Innovation Network in Munich including Entrepreneurship Centers, Start-Ups, Corporates and Investors. Establishing strategic partnership between SAP and UnternehmerTUM. Representing SAP on events like MUST Munich, Dahoam Conference or the opening of the Digital Product School.
